title: Load regulation from 0mA to 50mA at nominal VIN per corner
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Load regulation (0-50mA)" row (< 1% / 18mV, counted inside the +-2% Output window) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch), using two discrete DC operating-point solves at the row's own two endpoints (I_LOAD = 0mA and 50mA) at each corner's own VIN ('vsup'). That row is DRAFT (issue #1 not yet ratified) -- the bound below cites it directly, not an invented final limit, and needs re-verification once #1 rules. Two .op points, not a continuous 'dc iload 0 50m ...' sweep -- a continuous sweep was tried during this testbench's bring-up and did not track a single regulating branch across the whole range (a 51-point sweep at tt/27C/VIN=3.3V measured a 1.46V peak-to-peak vout excursion, over 80% of the 1.8V target, vs. ~4mV at the same corner's two endpoints via discrete .op solves); this is the same DC-solution-multiplicity family design/README.md's dated 2026-08-25 root-cause section documents for VIN sweeps (issue #60 mechanism 4, tracked by #71), now also observed load-current-side. load_reg_v is abs(vout_50ma - vout_0ma); load_reg_pct expresses the same delta as a percentage of the 1.8V DRAFT Output target, matching design/README.md's own load-regulation screening convention (which also uses discrete no-load/full-load points, not a sweep). Uses the DR-002 proposed nominal C_out/ESR (1uF/10mOhm), not a window sweep -- same convention as load-transient/dropout-vs-load/psrr-dc. Known risk, not a testbench defect: design/README.md's dated 2026-08-25 root-cause section (issue #60, mechanism 1; tracked by #69) documents a thermal-shutdown false-trip at the ff/sf process corners at 125C, independent of load current -- a corner at that condition is expected to report a non-physical number (pass device driven off), the same documented failure mode the four existing testbenches already show there.
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: load_reg_v
measurements.note: abs(vout@50mA - vout@0mA), the DRAFT row's own two endpoints. DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "Load regulation (0-50mA)" row, < 1% (18mV), counted inside the +-2% Output window.

measurements.name: load_reg_pct
measurements.note: Same delta as load_reg_v, expressed as a percentage of the 1.8V DRAFT Output target -- the same convention design/README.md's own load-regulation screening numbers use. DRAFT bound: < 1%.
